metadata.title: VULTURE public dataset
metadata.description:
This is the public dataset for VULTURE

the dataset is orgnized as following, can be used to detect 1-day  vulnerabilities in the wild.

  1. aligned_patch_commits.zip : dataset for LLM based commit mapping
    1. aligned_cpe: Each <product>.json file contains CVEs and related CPEs for the corresponding <product>.
    2. aligned_patch: Each <product> directory contains directories named after related CVEs. Inside each <CVE> directory, there is a patch_info.json file that describes the CVE, and two directories: patch_before and patch_after, which store the code before and after the patch, respectively.
  2. IoTList: dataset for selected TPLs
    1. it contains the GitHub link for selected TPLs in TPLFilter step
    2. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Vulture-17BC/iotList.txt
  3. signature.zip: dataset for TPLreuse detection & 1-day vulnerability detection
    1. osscollector: contains the birth date and function hash
    2. preprocessor: TPL information after filter
    3. All of the above can be directly used by VULTURE

--------------------------- 

BENCHMARKS

  1. Commit benchmark: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Vulture-17BC/CommitBenckmark
  2. Vulnerability benchmark: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Vulture-17BC/VulnerabilityBenckmark.xlsx

metadata.title: DOCUMENTATION OF RISIS DATASETS Doctoral Degree and Career Dataset (DDC)
metadata.description:
Documentation is presented for The Doctoral Degree and Career Dataset (DDC).  In the framework of the RISIS2 project, DDC is an experimental dissertation-centric database. It primarily consists of an enriched PhD publication dataset which brings togehter information about the dissertation (e.g., topic mapping), about the degree-granting university (e.g., geolocation), as well as basic information about the individual (e.g., gender). The DDC is also leveraging linkages in the RISIS Infrastructure to develop a caeer indicator.

This second iteration covers the PhD production for the full two cohorts (2010,2014) for six countries ( AT, DE, IL, NL, ES, NO). The documentation details the design and contents of the dataset.

grants.title: European Research Infrastructure for Science, technology and Innovation policy Studies 2

title: DOCUMENTATION OF RISIS DATASETS Doctoral Degree and Career Dataset (DDC)

metadata.title: Automotive Sensor Data. An Example Dataset from the AEGIS Big Data Project
metadata.description: This is an example research data dataset for the automotive demonstrator within the "AEGIS -  Advanced Big Data Value Chain for Public Safety and Personal Security" big data project, which has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement No 732189. The time series data has been collected by using a BeagleBone single plate computer which has been developed at VIF to collect data for driving analytics. The BeagleBoard can be connected to the OBD2 interface of a vehicle to capture data from CAN bus and has been additionally equipped with further sensors (GPS, gyroscope, acceleration). The data in this research dataset was collected during 35 different trips conducted by one driver driving one vehicle in the Graz area in Austria.
keywords: Vehicle Operation Data, Big Data, Sensor Data, BeagleBone
metadata.notes: Research dataset of the AEGIS project

title: Automotive Sensor Data. An Example Dataset from the AEGIS Big Data Project

metadata.title: DATASET: Proyectos de investigación Generación de Conocimiento del Plan Nacional I+D+i de España
metadata.description:
Este repositorio contiene un dataset de proyectos de investigación presentados en el marco del Plan Nacional de I+D desde 2004 hasta 2023. El dataset aglutina y harmoniza la información presente en las diferentes resoluciones de convocatorias publicadas en la web de la Agencia Estatal de Investigación. El dataset se presenta en profundidad en el artículo el artículo "Dos décadas de financiación competitiva en España: un análisis longitudinal del instrumento de financiación de proyectos de investigación del Plan Nacional de I+D+i (2004-2023)".

Los principales archivos del repositorio son:

  • proyectos_plan_nacional_2004_2023.csv: este dataset contiene proyectos de investigación presentados en el marco del Plan Nacional de I+D desde 2004 hasta 2023.
  • proyectos_resoluciones_fuentes.csv: este dataset contiene las fuentes de las que se ha extraído la información para la construcción del dataset de proyectos de investigación.
  • diccionario_areas_tematicas.csv: este dataset contiene el diccionario de áreas temáticas en las que se clasifican los proyectos de investigación.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This repository contains a dataset of research projects submitted under the National R&D Plan from 2004 to 2023. The dataset brings together and harmonizes the information present in the different resolutions of calls published on the website of the State Research Agency. The dataset is presented in depth in the article “Two decades of competitive funding in Spain: a longitudinal analysis of the research project funding instrument of the National R&D&I Plan (2004-2023)”.

The main repository archives are:

  • proyectos_plan_nacional_2004_2023.csv: This dataset contains a list of research projects submitted under the National R&D Plan from 2004 to 2023. It contains both accepted proposals (2004-2023) and rejected proposals (2009-2023).
  • proyectos_resoluciones_fuentes.csv: This dataset contains the sources from which the information for the construction of the research projects dataset has been extracted.
  • diccionario_areas_tematicas.csv: This dataset contains the dictionary of thematic areas in which research projects are classified.

metadata.title: OAGT Paper Topic Dataset
metadata.description:
OAGT is a paper topic dataset consisting of 6942930 records which comprise various scientific publication attributes like abstracts, titles, keywords, publication years, venues, etc. The last two fields of each record are the topic id from a taxonomy of 27 topics created from the entire collection and the 20 most significant topic words. Each dataset record (sample) is stored as a JSON line in the text file.

The data is derived from OAG data collection (https://aminer.org/open-academic-graph) which was released
under ODC-BY license.

This data (OAGT Paper Topic Dataset) is released under CC-BY license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

If using it, please cite the following paper:

Erion Çano, Benjamin Roth: Topic Segmentation of Research Article Collections. ArXiv 2022, CoRR abs/2205.11249, https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2205.11249

metadata.title: ASAP Field Research Dataset: Croatia
metadata.description: Anonymised datasets from quantitative (survey) field research conducted in Croatia within the ASAP project, involving pre-adolescents, parents and teachers. The datasets contain raw survey data on pre-adolescents’ relationship with digital and social media, with particular attention to cyberbullying and digital/media literacy. Data were collected using research protocols developed in compliance with ethical standards and approved by the Research Ethics Committee of DOBA Business School, Faculty of Applied Business and Social Studies (Maribor, Slovenia).

grants.title: ASAP – A Systemic APproach to social media and pre-adolescents through thinking skills education
